transcript: Climate change is reshaping the way we grow food. Farmers in many regions now face longer dry seasons and sudden heavy rains. Some are switching to crops that need less water, like millets and pulses. Others use drip irrigation to deliver water straight to the roots. Solar pumps are replacing diesel engines in many villages, cutting both cost and pollution. In cities, rooftop gardens and vertical farms grow vegetables close to the people who eat them. Scientists are breeding rice that can survive under water for two weeks. Weather apps on simple phones warn farmers before storms arrive. Cooperatives help small farmers share tractors, storage and fair prices. Soil health cards tell each farmer exactly which nutrients the field needs. Planting trees along field borders protects crops from wind and keeps the soil moist. Climate change is reshaping the way we grow food. selection_rule: Per scene: (1) statistics -> animated stat card. (2) Stock candidates from category-suited sources are scored with CLIP (image vs scene visual plan + narration, minus penalty for negative/avoid terms); unsafe candidates (avoid list, faces when avoided, AI for people/brands/sensitive) are removed. (3) Global assignment takes the highest (scene, clip) pairs first, each clip used once, if score >= tau=0.24. (4) If a scene's best stock score < tau+0.03 and AI is allowed, an AI image is generated and wins only if its CLIP score >= stock + 0.02. (5) Otherwise the best unused clip within 0.03 of tau, else a text card.
